skills.name: accessibility-audit
skills.description: Audit interfaces against WCAG 2.2 AA: keyboard navigation, ARIA semantics, accessible names, focus states, color contrast, and assistive tech support.

skills.name: agent-handoff
skills.description: Resume another agent's work or prepare a handoff with repository state, evidence, ownership, and next steps. Use after an interrupted session or before stopping.

skills.name: ai-tool-security
skills.description: Review AI tool execution, prompt injection boundaries, and outbound data access. Use when configuring agent tools, MCP permissions, shell automation, or AI provider access.

skills.name: api-design
skills.description: Design clear, contract-first APIs and module interfaces with boundary validation. Use when adding or changing an HTTP/RPC endpoint, a public library interface, or a service contract.

skills.name: bulk-reporting-export

skills.name: changelog-generator

skills.name: ci-cd

skills.name: code-review

skills.name: code-simplification
skills.description: Simplify code for clarity without changing behavior. Use when code works but is harder to read, maintain, or extend than it should be.

skills.name: codebase-onboarding
skills.description: Build a concise mental model of an unfamiliar repository: architecture, entry points, workflows, hotspots, and tests. Use when starting work in an unknown codebase.

skills.name: context-engineering
skills.description: Select and refresh the minimum context needed for an active task. Use when starting or resuming work, switching projects, or correcting stale agent context.

skills.name: context-privacy
skills.description: Design or review context sharing across clients, project groups, and teams. Use when deciding where private notes, sensitive data, credentials, or context packs belong.

skills.name: debugging
skills.description: Systematically diagnose and fix failures instead of guessing. Use when facing a bug, stack trace, failing test, crash, or unexpected behavior, or when a fix attempt did not work.

skills.name: dependency-audit
skills.description: Audit, upgrade, or rationalize third-party dependencies for security, licensing, and supply-chain risk. Use when adding dependencies, fixing audit findings, or upgrading packages.

skills.name: deprecation-and-migration
skills.description: Manage deprecation and migration. Use when removing old systems, APIs, or features, or when migrating users from one implementation to another.

skills.name: design-tokens
skills.description: Define and apply design tokens: naming by role, semantic tiers, theming, and dark mode switches. Use when establishing UI design tokens or themes.

skills.name: documentation-and-adrs
skills.description: Record architectural decisions and technical documentation. Use when making architectural decisions, changing public APIs, shipping features, or recording essential project context.

skills.name: doubt-driven-development
skills.description: Challenge consequential technical decisions against contracts and evidence. Use for uncertain architecture, security boundaries, or irreversible changes.

skills.name: frontend-state

skills.name: frontend-ui-engineering
skills.description: Build production-quality UIs: reusable primitives, responsibility decomposition, robust state handling, and complete visual states (hover, loading, error).

skills.name: git-workflow
skills.description: Use git well: atomic commits, clear messages, sensible branching, and clean PRs. Use when committing, branching, writing commit/PR messages, or resolving merge conflicts.

skills.name: incremental-implementation
skills.description: Deliver changes incrementally in small verifiable steps. Use when implementing features or changes touching multiple files to avoid unwieldy single diffs.

skills.name: java-code-standards

skills.name: mcp-builder

skills.name: observability

skills.name: performance-optimization

skills.name: planning-and-task-breakdown

skills.name: quarkus-service

skills.name: rest-api-contract

skills.name: security-hardening

skills.name: shipping-and-launch
skills.description: Prepare production launches. Use when deploying to production, preparing a pre-launch checklist, setting up monitoring, or planning a staged rollout.

skills.name: skill-creator

skills.name: skill-evaluation
skills.description: Evaluate whether a skill routes correctly and improves task outcomes. Use when adding or revising skills, investigating misfires, or comparing skill versions.

skills.name: source-driven-development
skills.description: Ground implementation decisions in official documentation. Use when you want authoritative, source-cited code free from outdated patterns or hallucinated APIs.

skills.name: spec-driven-development
skills.description: Create specifications before coding. Use when starting a new project, feature, or significant change and no specification exists yet.

skills.name: test-driven-development
skills.description: Drive development with tests. Use when implementing logic, fixing bugs, or changing behavior. Proves code works test-first before writing implementation.

skills.name: using-agent-skills

skills.name: web-development

skills.name: web-perf
